correctness.rationale: All-domain proof: Laplacian harmonic sum forces complementary firing; exact threshold intervals are necessary/sufficient. Complete-graph mass generating factors, temporal phase normalization, reciprocity and exact expectation follow algebraically. Stirling plus a uniform entropy tail bound yields the phase CLT and n^n/4 orbit asymptotic; conditional independent bounded uniforms give uniformly Gaussian mass at n^(3/2) scale and joint asymptotic independence. Standalone exact verification compares actual iterates and all mass coefficients on many finite graphs, but is not used as proof of the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The conserved mass is intrinsic to parallel chip-firing. An exact primitive-period-two orbit count at every mass on the fundamental mean-field graph K_n is a natural microcanonical invariant not supplied by period-existence theorems; its joint independent phase-imbalance/mass central limit describes two different macroscopic observables with two nontrivial fluctuation scales and gives useful quantitative structure for periodic-state sampling. Not a finite ad hoc slice or only a routine restatement of general firing-pattern constraints.
